Group rides in Minneapolis, MN

9 recurring group rides around Minneapolis, MN: 6 social, 4 road, 2 mountain bike. 6 roll on weeknights, 2 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Joyful Riders Club Monthly Ride at Fulton in Minneapolis — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Freewheel MPLS Wednesday Night Ride runs 15–17 mph average.
